The hoplite thrust animation has been changed to be a more fitting animation. This will result in an insurmountable immersion increase
Increased the Base Damage and scaling of Elemental Anamoly by 8%.
Fixed an issue where Bloody Maelstrom's AP scalar was not being applied, additionally the base damage and scaling has been increased by 8%.
Starburst Barrage will now instantly trigger an Arcane Explosion upon cast, instead of having a 1.5 second delay making 4 total explosions over 6 seconds up from 3.
In Sword We Trust now also increases the damage contribution to Righteous Vengeance from Crusader Strike by 3% per stack.
Flare Strike now has a 30 second cooldown from 35 seconds.
Fixed an issue where Arena gear would say you had too low of a personal rating to purchase it from the vendor.
Fixed an issue where some golden skillcards from Silas Darkmoon had the wrong cost, namely Seal of Vengeance costing 2,500 gold instead of 1,000 gold when it is a rare card.
Fixed an issue where the Blood Bowl would not reward the winner.
Fixed an issue where the Crow's Cache would sometimes fail to spawn.
Fixed an issue where you could not train the recipe for the Khroium Balanced Destroyer. This recipe will now come out with Karazhan in the future.
NPCs in Southshore vs Tarrenmill should now inherit proper factions and attack the opposing faction.

Added a new aura called Reprieve to Southshore vs Tarrenmill. This aura is applied on resurrection, lasts 15 seconds and increases your damage done and reduces your damage taken by 15%. This is intended to help graveyard camping.

4.description: Disabled the Horrify spell from Netherwing Whelp as it was not intended to use that specific spell.

1.description: Corrected an issue preventing Twisted, Dread and Void Enchanting recipes from dropping from Raid trash mobs.
Corrected an issue preventing Twisted, Dread and Void Cooking and Alchemy recipes from dropping from Raid trash mobs.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Fel Comm would not report accurate gold costs.
Fixed an issue that stopped Felcomm from working after recent updates.
Fixed an issue that caused Aura of Reputation to disappear.
[Requires Patch Update] - Fixed an issue in the display of some mounts not properly displaying the correct mount speed.
Re-enabled Blood Bowl after fixing an issue where the loot would sometimes not be sent to the winner.

[Al'ar] - Arena Season 1 has began! You can now climb the ladder, earn rewards and possibly even the end-of-arena-season rewards. The cost of the rare honor gear has been reduced by upwards of 50% with this release compared to pre-season. Epic offpieces are now available for Honor and you may now earn rating towards purchasing Arena Gear!

6.description: The chance to obtain Nether Leather while skinning beasts in HR T1,2 and 3 zones has been adjusted on a per mob and density basis. This change is necessary due to beasts also dropping Nether Meat. This change will keep skinning a highly valuable profession in HR farming Materails and Marks while ensuring it does feel mandatory or significantly outpace other ways of farming Marks.

3.description: Tooth and Nail now increases the damage of Shockwave versus players by 15%, changed from 20%.

4.description: (These changes are made primarily to target melee and healer setups which have been very strong in 2v2 leading to few viable-feeling setups. Arms builds in general have had a bit too powerful healing reduction while still dishing out great damage.)
Mortal Strike, Demolishing Strike, Rend, Overpower, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Mutilate (Titan), Counterattack, Mongoose Bite and Deep Wounds now deals 5% reduced damage in 2v2 and 3v3 arena.
Unrelenting Assault now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 4 sec.
Mortal Strike now reduces the healing received by 35%, changed from 40%.

Cleanse and Dispel Magic can now only be used on other friendly targets in 2v2 and 3v3 arena while you have Spirit Primary Stat. (This is an experimental change being tested. It can be difficult to get crowd control to stick to a healer if his partner runs a dispel, leading to too few windows of opportunity.)
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Touched by the Light heal did not work.

2.description: Fixed an issue where High-Risk beasts were not correctly dropping Nether Leather when skinned.

4.description: [Extraordinary Riding]  Is now available from any Flying trainer!  This allows for all flying mounts to scale to 310% riding speed.

0.description: Reduced the PvP Power requirement to queue for Arenas to 250. Players now choosing to gear up in Normal and Heroic Bloodforged will have the required PvP power to queue for solo 2v2 Arena.

6.description: Reduced the Bloodbringer buff at Gruul's Lair Heroic Bloodforged High-Risk event to 25% increased health from 125%, and 10% increased damage from 25%. This should make these mobs far more reasonable and effective to farm as a solo player in a 1v1 zone.

2.description: TBC High-Risk Engineering Lenses can now be applied to Wands, Guns, Bows and Crossbows. (Pending Restart and Spell Patch Update)
Renamed TBC High-Risk Engineering Scopes to Lenses.

These changes are aimed at ensuring that you are properly rewarded for your time spent farming High-Risk and High-Risk Events. This will result in significantly more consumables and item enchants produced per farming session and event.

Epic Recipes: Epic Twisted, Dread and Void Material cost is now 3, reduced from 5.
Rare recipes: Now require 2 Rare Nether Materials, reduced from 5.
